question.text: On the Innovators Growth Platform (IGP), which category of investors is NOT permitted to participate?

answer.text: IGP-qualified individual investors with Rs. 50 lakh annual income and Rs. 5 crore liquid net worth

explanation.text: The Logic: The Innovators Growth Platform (IGP) is accessible only to institutional and non-institutional investors; Retail Individual Investors are not permitted to participate. The Trap: An IGP-eligible individual investor — one who has at least Rs. 50 lakh annual income AND at least Rs. 5 crore minimum liquid net worth — is permitted, but is classified separately from a retail individual investor. Candidates may confuse "individual" with "retail." Note: The IGP framework limits access to investor classes that meet specified financial thresholds, reflecting the higher-risk nature of the issuers it lists.
